parameters.query:
INSERT INTO dao_governance_reports (
  report_id,
  proposal_id,
  proposal_title,
  proposer,
  total_votes,
  for_percentage,
  against_percentage,
  current_outcome,
  ai_recommendation,
  ai_confidence,
  auto_voted,
  vote_tx_hash
) VALUES (
  '{{ $json.governance_report_id }}',
  '{{ $json.proposal.id }}',
  '{{ $json.proposal.title }}',
  '{{ $json.proposal.proposer }}',
  {{ $json.voting_status.total_votes }},
  {{ $json.voting_status.for_percentage }},
  {{ $json.voting_status.against_percentage }},
  '{{ $json.voting_status.current_outcome }}',
  '{{ $json.ai_recommendation.vote }}',
  {{ $json.ai_recommendation.confidence }},
  {{ $json.auto_vote_decision }},
  '{{ $('Cast DAO Vote On-Chain').item.json.transactionHash || "" }}'
) RETURNING *;
